ogtr:DIR-201.name: DIR 201 — GM wheat & barley field trial (yield enhancement)
ogtr:DIR-201.type: GM wheat and barley field trial
ogtr:DIR-201.desc: Field trial of wheat and barley genetically modified for yield enhancement. One site in Light Regional Council, South Australia, maximum two hectares per year, May 2024 to January 2029. Not permitted in human food or animal feed. Location shown at council level — open the licence page for the site conditions.
